purpose: Held-out test of question-relative typed responsibility relations after EX2-A rejected fixed five-axis classification.

relationTypes.DECIDES_SEMANTICS: Who decides the meaning/strategy/domain conclusion explicitly asked by the scenario?
relationTypes.OWNS_STATE_SEMANTICS: Who defines the contract/meaning of the named durable state? This is not the storage carrier.
relationTypes.PERSISTS_VIA: Which carrier/substrate physically persists the named state while not taking over its semantics?
relationTypes.PROVES_NATIVE_FACT: Which native owner can prove the named provider/domain occurrence or current state?
relationTypes.PROVES_LOCAL_EXECUTION: Which owner can prove the named local process/byte execution fact?
relationTypes.MAPS_OR_DERIVES: Who transforms source evidence into the named mapped/normalized/derived fact without replacing source authority?
relationTypes.RECONCILES_IDENTITY: Who owns the exact effect/trajectory identity used to recover an ambiguous consequence?
relationTypes.ADMITS_CONSEQUENCE: Who admits the consequence/commitment at the boundary explicitly asked?
relationTypes.VERIFIES_ACCEPTANCE: Who judges whether evidence satisfies the named domain/task objective?
relationTypes.TIME_COORDINATE: Who owns the meaning/value of the named time coordinate?
relationTypes.SEMANTIC_HOME: Where should the responsibility's domain semantics live?
relationTypes.DELEGATES_MECHANICS_TO: Which mature substrate should implement the mechanical part without becoming semantic authority?
relationTypes.PROMOTION_STATUS: Should this responsibility be retained shared, kept local, delegated to classical machinery, or not promoted?
relationTypes.DOES_NOT_IMPLY: Which tempting stronger inference is explicitly invalid?

treatments.compact_responsibility: World is a narrow external adapter/trajectory boundary. Host owns long-lived Task/Effect/Dispatch continuity; World owns provider/Resource/Message/Entity adapter and correlation semantics carried through Host extension state; providers and source/destination domains retain native execution, occurrence, materialization, currentness and truth. World maps provider evidence and reconciles the original external identity after ambiguity; missing receipt is not proof of no effect. Browser bundle verification proves cross-object integrity, not page truth. Provider completion, World first availability and Host admission are separate times. Generic capability/path ranking was deleted when it showed no fresh-Agent decision benefit. Runtime owns local process execution, not World. Finance owns owner-capital domain semantics: Owner Constitution, evidence/portfolio/belief/decision state, exact finance effect identity, reconciliation and causal accounting. The Primary Finance Agent chooses investment strategy; deterministic Finance services compute readiness, accounting and reconciliation predicates. Venue/public/account observations remain venue/provider-native; Finance normalizes them and decides Finance contract assessments without becoming occurrence authority. A dispatch claim or local process success is not an OKX order receipt; ambiguous writes reconcile through deterministic external identity. Event time is not knowledge time. Trial count is not admitted winners. Mature databases, numerical libraries and schedulers remain classical machinery; Finance-specific semantics stay Finance-local; provider/domain semantics stay provider/domain-local; absent repeated cross-domain pressure, do not invent a shared layer.
treatments.typed_relations: Do not assign a universal owner or fill fixed columns. Answer only the relation asked. Distinguish: DECIDES_SEMANTICS from OWNS_STATE_SEMANTICS; state contract ownership from PERSISTS_VIA storage carrier; PROVES_NATIVE_FACT from PROVES_LOCAL_EXECUTION; source fact from MAPS_OR_DERIVES normalization/integrity; external occurrence from RECONCILES_IDENTITY; admission from verification. World owns the semantics of its provider/Resource/Message/Entity correlation state but may PERSIST_VIA Host extension CAS; Host does not thereby own World semantics. Runtime proves local Job/process/Artifact execution but not provider/domain occurrence. External provider/source/destination proves its native effect/state. World may map provider evidence or prove Browser cross-object integrity without replacing provider/domain truth. Finance owns capital/evidence/decision/effect/reconciliation state semantics; Finance may derive readiness, reconciliation assessments and ledger effects from provider-native observations without becoming the native occurrence owner. The Agent/domain decides investment/scientific/game meaning unless a named deterministic Finance contract predicate is explicitly the subject. Finance semantic responsibilities can DELEGATE_MECHANICS_TO SQLite/Parquet/DuckDB/Polars/numerical libraries while remaining Finance-local. PROMOTION_STATUS is separate from semantic home: a Finance-local optimizer can delegate classical math and still be NOT_PROMOTED as a new shared Ordivon engine. Negative laws include: missing receipt DOES_NOT_IMPLY not committed; provider receipt DOES_NOT_IMPLY Task completion; bundle integrity DOES_NOT_IMPLY page truth; dispatch claim DOES_NOT_IMPLY venue order occurrence; local process success DOES_NOT_IMPLY external financial effect; fill DOES_NOT_IMPLY cash bill; event_time DOES_NOT_IMPLY knowledge time; admitted winners DO_NOT_IMPLY attempted-trial count. Time coordinates keep native owners: provider completion, World first availability, Host admission.

cases.scenario: A World ResourceTransfer record has a World-defined transferId/state machine, but its durable bytes are stored inside the Host world extension CAS. Which relation pair describes this without transferring semantic ownership to Host?

A Cloudflare request may already be committed after response loss. World retains the exact provider request identity and recovery mapping, while Cloudflare's receipt endpoint is the native source for whether that request exists. Answer the two distinct responsibilities.

World verifies that a Browser Receipt, Manifest, PNG and HTML are one internally consistent generation. The next question is whether the rendered page actually contains a correct answer to the user's research question.
A provider completed at 10:00:00, World first had the validated complete observation at 10:00:12, and Host admitted it at 10:00:13. Identify the owner of each named coordinate.
A Message is delivered from Game into Security's durable inbox. Delivery is structurally valid. Does that fact by itself prove the foreign proposition is true in Security?

A team proposes restoring a universal World route ranker. Current providers expose observations, the Agent can choose, physical owners revalidate, and the previous generic projection had no measured decision benefit. Where do route-choice semantics live and what is the promotion status?

Runtime launches a local controller process that calls a robot API. After response loss, the question 'did the local process run?' and the question 'did the robot physically actuate?' require different proofs.

A Finance Venue World snapshot contains OKX-native account/market observations. Finance recomputes readyForRiskIncrease from those observations and official rules. Identify native observation proof and the derived readiness assessment owner.
readyForRiskIncrease is true. The remaining question is whether buying more XAU is economically attractive for the owner. Who decides that semantic question?

Finance recorded an immutable dispatch claim for an OKX order but no venue write has yet been observed. Which owner owns the dispatch-claim state semantics, and which owner can later prove order occurrence?

A local Finance executor lost the response after one possible order POST. Runtime proves the local process attempt. Finance's deterministic clOrdId identifies what to reconcile. OKX order lookup proves whether an order exists.

OKX reports fills and account bills. Finance normalizes those observations and materializes Capital Ledger cash effects only from Venue Bills. Identify the native source and the domain derivation owner.

A market event occurred before historical cutoff D, but Finance only observed/registered it after D. What owner defines the Finance knowledge-time query semantics, and what tempting inference is invalid?

Finance needs robust covariance and matrix optimization. Numerical libraries already implement the mechanics; Finance still owns the portfolio/evidence meaning of inputs and outputs. Identify semantic home, mechanical delegation and promotion status.

A Finance research protocol declares the holdout sealed and exact visible inputs. Runtime contained execution physically ensures the Agent process cannot read undeclared host files. Who owns the research-input policy semantics and who proves physical isolation?

An experiment has 1,000 attempted candidates but only two promoted results. Multiple-testing accounting asks for actual search attempts, while the scientific interpretation of what search count means remains a research/domain judgment.

A Game-only evaluator defines whether one gameplay experiment is fun under Game-specific evidence. Common Runtime/Harness machinery may execute it, but no materially different domain shares the evaluator meaning. Identify semantic home and promotion status.

A generic batch scheduler already supplies priorities, worker placement and deterministic retry, and no Agent-specific continuity/effect invariant remains. Where should the mechanics go and should a new shared Ordivon scheduler be promoted?

Host stores a semantic checkpoint that references a Runtime Job id. Hours later we need to know whether that exact Job is physically running. Who owns the checkpoint semantics, and who proves current Job execution state?

A World adapter maps a provider Receipt into Host Observation evidence. The provider Receipt proves provider-native occurrence; the Host Observation is a durable mapped record. Which relation identifies the mapper and which identifies native proof?

A Finance deterministic reconciliation algorithm classifies complete venue evidence as matched. A later domain question asks whether the trade was a good investment. Identify the reconciliation derivation and the investment judgment.

One external provider responsibility is provider-native and one narrow World correlation/reconciliation seam has two materially different consumers. State the semantic home of provider occurrence and the promotion status of the World seam.

A finance-specific reconciliation evaluator is useful in Finance but no other domain shares its accounting meaning. Its database transactions use SQLite. Identify semantic home, mechanical substrate, and shared-promotion status.

A provider Receipt exists and World successfully maps it into Host evidence. The Task asks whether the fetched scientific source supports a hypothesis. Which component proves provider occurrence, which maps the evidence, and who verifies objective acceptance?

metrics.queryExact: exact answer for each explicitly asked relation query
metrics.caseExact: all relation queries correct within one case

classification.RELATIONS_SUPPORTED: typed_relations queryExact >= compact + 0.05 AND typed_relations caseExact >= 0.90 AND criticalNativeFact >= 0.98 AND ownerCarrier >= 0.95 AND minimality >= 0.90
classification.SAFE_NONINFERIOR: typed_relations queryExact >= 0.95 AND typed_relations >= compact - 0.01 AND criticalNativeFact = 1.0 AND ownerCarrier >= compact AND minimality >= compact

antiLeakage: new R01-R24 wording; no A01-A24 scenario is reused verbatim
only explicitly asked relations are scored
paired credential slot and alternating treatment order
no semantic answer repair or prior-result replay
